What is AIAPGET?

All India AYUSH Postgraduate Entrance Test, commonly known as AIAPGET, is conducted for admissions to the postgraduate courses in Ayurveda , Unani , Siddha and Homeopathy . The National Testing Agency (NTA) on behalf of the Ministry of AYUSH, Government of India conducts AIAPGET exam. It is conducted annually in a computer-based mode. Candidates who qualify for the examination scoring the minimum cut off percentile can opt for MS, MD, or PG diploma courses in the above-mentioned disciplines. Admission for MS, MD, or PG diploma courses in Ayurveda, Unani, Siddha and Homeopathy is given on the basis of merit. Those who qualify AIAPGET 2026 will be asked for counselling round which is conducted by AYUSH Admissions Central Counseling Committee (AACCC). Read all details about AIAPGET 2026 here.

Candidates should have an idea about the AIAPGET 2026 exam pattern so that they know every aspect of test paper including type of questions asked and weightage. AIAPGET exam pattern comprises important details including mode, medium, total number of questions, time duration, and marking scheme. As per AIAPGET pattern , question paper comprises 120 multiple choice questions of 480 marks. Exam timing will be 2 hours. NTA will conduct exam in computer-based mode. As per marking scheme, candidates will get 4 marks for right and -1 marks for the wrong answers. No mark will be awarded or deducted for unanswered questions.

AIAPGET 2026 Counselling

Once students qualify AIAPGET exam, they will have to participate in AIAPGET counselling for allotment of All India Quota seats. It must be noted, students will have to score minimum cut off marks to participate in counselling process, conducted by AYUSH Admissions Central Counselling Committee (AACCC). To participate in the AIAPGET counselling, candidates will have to register on the official portal and fill in the choice of colleges and courses in which they seek admission. The counselling will be conducted online and will be based on the rank secured by the candidate in the examination. Based on the choice filled by the candidate, All India Rank, the availability of seats, reservation criteria and other factors, seats will be allocated for AYUSH courses. Selected candidates have to report to the allocated institute with the requisite documents for confirmation of his/her admission. Round-1 counselling has already been completed.

faqs.answer: According to AIAPGET exam pattern, there will be no descriptive questions in exam. Questions will be objective type. So, there will be no long answer questions in AIAPGET 2025. A total of 120 questions will be asked in AIAPGET exam and students will be given 120 minutes to answer them.

faqs.question: I am 32 years old. Can I apply for AIAPGET?
faqs.answer: Yes, there is no upper age limit for the candidates appearing for AIAPGET. Therefore, you can apply for this examination. Candidates are advised to read all the eligibility criteria before applying online for the exam. Like age, there is no capping on number of attempts for AIAPGET. Candidates can appear as many times as they want. One of the important eligibility criteria for AIAPGET exam candidates should have BAMS/ BUMS/ BSMS/ BHMS/Graded BHMS degree and must have completed one year internship in the given deadline.

faqs.question: Who conducts AIAPGET exam?
faqs.answer: The National Testing Agency NTA is responsible for conducting the All India AYUSH Postgraduate Entrance Test. However, NTA's role is limited to conducting the examination and processing the results. The admission/ counselling is conducted under the supervision of the AYUSH Admissions Central Counseling Committee (AACCC). Eligible candidates have to participate in the counselling process for seat allotment. They have to register and declare preference for college and course for counselling.

faqs.question: What is the question pattern for the AIAPGET?
faqs.answer: AIAPGET Exam Pattern: 1- Mode of the examination: Online (computer-based) 2- Medium of the question paper: 1- Ayurveda: English and Hindi 2- Unani: English and Urdu 3- Homeopathy: English only 4- Siddha: English and Tamil 3- Duration of the examination: 2 hours 4- Total number of questions: 120 5- Total marks: 480 6- Type of Questions: Objective type 7- Negative marking: Yes.

faqs.question: Will there be negative marking in AIAPGET?
faqs.answer: Yes, there is negative marking in AIAPGET. As per the existing exam pattern, for each incorrect response, one mark is deducted.

faqs.question: I had marked two questions for review in AIAPGET. Both of them were incorrect. Will marks be deducted for them?
faqs.answer: If you have marked two questions for review in AIAPGET and both of them are incorrect, marks will be deducted for them. The answers marked for review will be treated as attempted and will be marked accordingly. So, if you have marked two incorrect questions for review, you will lose 2 marks for each incorrect question. However, if you have marked two correct questions for review, you will receive 2 marks for each correct question. Marking scheme is released along with the official information brochure.
